fact: INSTAT's Atsinanana regional socio-economic dashboard of October 2024 publishes administrative statistics for 2019-2023 from the Toamasina commune civil registry (births, deaths), tax service records (taxpayers, receipts) and prison and justice records.
title: Tableau de bord socio-économique de la région Atsinanana 2023
publisher: Institut National de la Statistique (INSTAT), Direction interrégionale de Toamasina
